source: Frozen legal-choice replay: 144 held-out decisions, four seeds; native immediate-reward proxy. All-Gemma is a reference policy, not an oracle.

example.situation: Early morning, day 1. Arun, the carpenter (proud, hardworking, stubborn), at the village square. Carries 3 wood, 5 coins; 4 meals at home. Knows: The river flooded and washed the bridge away. Upset with Jonah. Just now: News: The river flooded and washed the bridge away.

gemma.action: check the joints of the bridge
gemma.reason: He must inspect the damage himself before deciding what to do next.

example.router: Kept Julia; no Gemma call in the replay policy.

batching.scope: Separate synchronized public 1,000-agent garden fixture, 120 selected; identical reference actions. Not the eight-person village.
